rows.sql: select count(*) as new_signups_april from dim_user where signup_date >= '2026-04-01' and signup_date < '2026-05-01'; select count(*) as new_signups_april from dim_users where signup_date >= '2026-04-01' and signup_date < '2026-05-01'; select signup_date, count(*) as c from dim_users where signup_date >= '2026-04-01' and signup_date < '2026-05-01' group by signup_date order by signup_date;

select snapshot_month, count(distinct user_id) as paying_users
from fct_subscription_months
group by snapshot_month
order by snapshot_month desc
limit 1;
select value, count(*) as cnt from (select metric_time, value from metrics_monthly_active_users where metric_time >= '2026-06-01' and metric_time <= '2026-06-30') t group by value order by cnt desc;

select count(*) as signups from dim_user where signup_date >= '2026-03-01' and signup_date <= '2026-03-31'; select count(*) as signups from dim_users where signup_date >= '2026-03-01' and signup_date <= '2026-03-31';

select count(*) as total_habits, count(archived_date) as archived_habits, count(*) - count(archived_date) as active_habits
from dim_habits;

select count(*) as annual_subscriptions_sold
from subscription
where plan_interval = 'annual'; select count(*) as annual_subscriptions_sold
from fct_subscriptions
where plan ilike '%annual%' or plan ilike '%year%' or billed_amount is not null and (plan is null) and false;

select count(distinct user_id) as ever_active
from activity
; select count(distinct user_id) as ever_active
from s2_before.activity;

select count(distinct user_id) as mau_may_2026
from fct_activity a
join dim_user u using (user_id)
where u.is_internal = false
  and a.active_date between '2026-05-01' and '2026-05-31';

select count(*) as annual_subscriptions_sold
from subscription
where lower(plan) like '%annual%'
  or interval = 'year'
  or lower(plan) like '%year%';

select u.user_id
from dim_users u
join fct_subscriptions s using (user_id)
where u.signup_date >= '2026-05-01' and u.signup_date < '2026-06-01'
  and s.plan = 'annual'
  and u.is_internal = false
  and u.is_test = false; select count(distinct u.user_id) as annual_users_may2026
from dim_users u
join fct_subscriptions s using (user_id)
where u.signup_date >= '2026-05-01' and u.signup_date < '2026-06-01'
  and s.plan = 'annual'
  and u.is_internal = false
  and u.is_test = false;
select count(*) as fitness_habits from dim_habits where category = 'fitness';

select count(*) as annual_count from fct_subscriptions where plan = 'annual'; select count(*) as annual_started_2026 from fct_subscriptions where plan='annual' and started_date >= '2026-01-01' and started_date <= '2026-07-12';

select count(distinct u.user_id) as annual_plan_users
from dim_user u
join fct_subscription s on u.user_id = s.user_id
where u.signup_date >= '2026-05-01' and u.signup_date < '2026-06-01'
  and s.plan = 'annual'
  and s.is_active = true;
select count(*) as total_signups from dim_user; select count(*) as total_signups from dim_users; select count(*) as total_signups from dim_users;

select count(*) as total_new_signups
from dim_user
where signup_date >= '2026-05-01'
  and signup_date < '2026-06-01'; select count(*) as total_new_signups
from dim_users
where signup_date >= '2026-05-01' and signup_date < '2026-06-01';

select count(*) as subscriptions_started
from fct_subscription_term t
join dim_users u on t.user_id = u.user_id
where not u.is_internal
  and t.started_date between date '2026-03-01' and date '2026-03-31';

select count(*) as annual_subscriptions
from fct_subscription_month_snapshot s
join dim_users u using (user_id)
where s.plan = 'annual'
  and not u.is_internal;
 select plan, count(*) as rows
from fct_subscription_month_snapshot s
join dim_users u using (user_id)
where not u.is_internal
group by plan
order by rows desc;

select count(distinct u.user_id) as annual_signups_may2026
from dim_users u
join fct_subscription_term t on u.user_id = t.user_id
where u.is_internal = false
  and u.signup_date >= '2026-05-01' and u.signup_date <= '2026-05-31'
  and t.plan = 'annual'
select count(*) as total_habits from dim_habits;
select value::bigint as signups_count from metric_new_signups_monthly where metric_time = '2026-03-01' limit 1;

select count(*) as count
from fct_subscription_term t
join dim_users u on t.user_id = u.user_id
where t.started_date between '2026-03-01' and '2026-03-31'
  and not u.is_internal; select status, count(*) from fct_subscription_term t join dim_users u on t.user_id = u.user_id where t.started_date between '2026-03-01' and '2026-03-31' and not u.is_internal group by 1 order by 2 desc;

select count(*) as annual_subscriptions_sold
from fct_subscription_term t
join dim_users u using (user_id)
where not u.is_internal
  and (t.plan ilike '%annual%' or t.plan ilike '%year%')
  and t.started_date is not null;

select count(*) as annual_signups_may
from dim_users u
join fct_subscription_term t on u.user_id = t.user_id
where u.is_internal = false
  and u.signup_date >= '2026-05-01' and u.signup_date <= '2026-05-31'
  and t.plan = 'annual'
  and t.started_date <= '2026-05-31' -- subscription started on or before end of may
  and (t.ended_date is null or t.ended_date >= '2026-05-01');
select count(*) as total from dim_habits where category = 'fitness';
select count(*) as total_signups from dim_users where not is_internal;

select count(distinct user_id) as mau_june
from fct_activity
where active_date >= '2026-06-01' and active_date <= '2026-06-30'
  and user_id in (select id from dim_user where is_internal = false);

select count(distinct user_id) as users_may_2026
from fct_activity a
join dim_user u using(user_id)
where a.active_date between '2026-05-01' and '2026-05-31'
  and u.is_internal = false;

select count(*) as subscriptions_started
from fct_subscription_term t
join dim_users u using (user_id)
where not u.is_internal
  and t.started_date >= '2026-03-01' and t.started_date <= '2026-03-31';

select count(*) as annual_subscriptions_sold
from fct_subscription_term t
join dim_users u on t.user_id = u.user_id
where lower(t.plan) = 'annual' and not u.is_internal;

select count(distinct u.user_id) as annual_signed_may
from dim_users u
join fct_subscription_term s on u.user_id = s.user_id
where u.is_internal = false
  and u.signup_date >= '2026-05-01' and u.signup_date <= '2026-05-31'
  and s.plan = 'annual'
  and s.started_date <= '2026-07-12' -- subscriptions that started by last full data date
  and (s.ended_date is null or s.ended_date > '2026-05-31')
; select count(distinct u.user_id) as annual_signed_may_active_on_snapshot
from dim_users u
join fct_subscription_month_snapshot m on u.user_id = m.user_id
where u.is_internal = false
  and u.signup_date between '2026-05-01' and '2026-05-31'
  and m.plan = 'annual'
  and m.snapshot_month = '2026-07-01'
;
